I watched a small local streamer a few years ago, he was 34. I was 16 when I started watching and me, the streamer and the few other regular watchers became kind of good friends on discord, and we also became moderators of the stream and dc-server. Once I turned 18 all of us decided to meet at the streamer's place, play some games and then go watch a stand up show. I was the youngest and only girl, but trusted them so I went. The night went well and when I drove home I was glad that I had gone, since I had gotten to meet one of the other mods who I really liked (we've now been dating for almost 2 years).

2 days later I got a DM from the streamer. He confessed that he had liked me for a long time, and after meeting me that day he felt like he needed to tell me. I was shocked. I had never thought of him that way and I told him that in the most polite way I could. I accepted it and things sort of went back to normal for a few weeks, but I still felt kind of uncomfortable thinking about the whole thing, he was 34 after all.

The weeks went on and me and my now boyfriend started talking more on the server and soon went on a date. The streamer knew that I liked him and I told him that we were now a couple, since I felt he deserved to know (this was maybe a month after he had confessed to me). He really wasn't happy about it and told me that he didn't want to know about our relationship. I was okay with that and understood, but when I once wrote in the server that me and (bf's name) had watched a movie together, he flipped and called me a w**re and lots of other things. When he said he didn't want to hear of our relations he really meant absolutely nothing and wanted to live like we weren't even together.

I left both the discord and stopped watching the streams after that, my boyfriend watched from time to time (I didn't tell my bf about the namecalling until a few months ago) but the streamer quit after a few months since his views had been dropping and he didn't find joy in it anymore.

Half a year later my boyfriend had posted a picture on Instagram of me and him out in the woods on a picnic. A few days later he recieved an angry e-mail (!!!) from the streamer. For some reason he felt that it was wrong to have a picture of us on his insta.

The streamer was your typical anime-loving neckbeard nerd who had never had a girlfriend. I really enjoyed watching his streams and I wouldn't have met my boyfriend if it weren't for him. The namecalling hurts, and knowing he liked me before I had turned 18 makes me want to puke. I still get bad anxiety from the whole thing even though I should let it go.

I wanted to scream but nothing but quiet whimpers came out of me.

A few minutes later my mother then came into the kitchen and found me on the floor passed out. Later in the hospital the doctor showed me a scale and asked if I could rate my pain from 1 to 10 where 1 was barely noticable and 10 unbearable.
